answer: Fingerprints are counted in trellis, which means the distribution is public, and vault lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a lotus header, so 1352 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
